use_cases.title: AI-Enhanced Applicant Screening and Matching
use_cases.description: Implement an AI system that automatically parses submitted CVs, extracts relevant qualifications, certifications, and experience, and matches them to the specific job titles listed on the career page (e.g., Master, Chief Officer, Engineer). The system can flag candidates who meet the required certificates (D1-D4, M1-M4, SEL, Cook) and language requirements (Scandinavian-speaking). This reduces manual screening time and ensures consistent evaluation.
use_cases.expected_value: Faster recruitment cycle, higher quality matches, reduced administrative burden for HR.

use_cases.title: AI-Optimized Crew Rostering and Compliance Management
use_cases.description: Use AI to create optimal crew rosters for each vessel, taking into account crew certifications, language proficiency, and legal requirements. The system can automatically generate schedules that comply with maritime regulations and company policies, while balancing crew workload and ensuring that each vessel has the required mix of roles (e.g., Chief Officer, Engineer, Cook, Stewardess).
use_cases.expected_value: Improved crew utilization, compliance assurance, reduced scheduling conflicts.

use_cases.title: AI-Driven Predictive Maintenance for Offshore Vessels
use_cases.description: Deploy AI models that analyze sensor data from vessel equipment (engines, generators, electrical systems) to predict potential failures before they occur. By forecasting maintenance needs, the company can schedule repairs proactively, minimizing downtime and extending equipment life.
use_cases.expected_value: Reduced unplanned downtime, lower maintenance costs, increased vessel availability.

limitations: The analysis is based on the company's registry data (brreg:nace, brreg:employees, brreg:place) and the career page content from the company's website (websearch:text). No additional internal data or external sources were used. The suggestions are limited by the available information, which does not include detailed operational data, vessel specifications, or internal processes.
